headline: Waaree Renewable secures 5 MWp solar project from PSU
hook: New solar contract for Waaree Renewable
summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies has received a Letter of Acceptance for a 5 MWp grid-connected solar project from a public sector undertaking. The contract involves a turnkey Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) mandate. The project is scheduled for completion within 12 months, followed by a 10-year operations and maintenance period.
why_it_matters: Secures long-term revenue stream through 10-year maintenance contract.

headline: Waaree Renewable Technologies bags new order contract
summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies announced it has received a new order or contract, as per an exchange filing. The specific value, client, and capacity details of the contract were not disclosed in this initial notification. Such order wins contribute to the company's unexecuted order book and future revenue visibility. Retail investors tracking renewable energy stocks should monitor subsequent disclosures for order size and execution timelines.
whats_next: Company disclosure on order value and execution timeline
why_it_matters: Order wins boost future revenue visibility for shareholders.
